party.description: A person or organization named on the invoice.

address.description: The party's postal address, on one line, as the invoice prints it.
address.title: Address

name.description: The party's name, as the invoice prints it.
name.title: Name

party.title: Party

inputs/invoice.schema.json.description: One invoice: its number, when it was issued, who issued it and to whom, the currency of its amounts, the items it invoices, and optionally notes.

buyer.description: Who the invoice is issued to and is to pay.
buyer.title: Buyer

currency.description: The currency of every amount on the invoice, as its three-letter ISO 4217 code.
currency.title: Currency

issued.description: The date the invoice was issued, as an RFC 3339 full-date. The invoice prints it as given.
issued.title: Issued

lines.description: The items invoiced, in the order the table lists them.

description.description: What the line invoices, as the table prints it.
description.title: Description

quantity.description: How many units the line invoices: hours, days or items. It may be fractional.
quantity.title: Quantity

unit_price.description: The price of one unit, in the invoice's currency.
unit_price.title: Unit price

lines.title: Lines

notes.description: Anything the buyer should read beside the amounts, such as how to pay. Left out, the invoice prints no notes.
notes.title: Notes

number.description: The number the seller gave the invoice, as the heading prints it.
number.title: Invoice number

seller.description: Who issues the invoice and is to be paid.
seller.title: Seller

inputs/invoice.schema.json.title: Invoice

invoice.description: One invoice, as the billing program that issues it holds it.
invoice.title: Invoice
